title: Crash when ALT + TABBING the "Run Project" window on Windows + AMD if running in windowed mode at monitor resolution
body:
### Tested versions

Godot [4.6.2.stable.steam]



### System information

Windows 11 - Godot[4.6.2.stable.steam] + amd adrealine[26.3.1] -  GPU ASUS Prime Radeon RX 9070XT - AMD 7800X3D

### Issue description

ISSUE:
Amd adrealine and godot crashes 100% of the time when alt tabbing the "Run Project" window, **ONLY** with the following project settings values:

Display → Window:

    Viewport Width: 1920

    Viewport Height: 1080

    Mode: Windowed



### Steps to reproduce

Observations:

    The crash seems to occur 100% of the time only with the specific combination of Windowed mode + 1920×1080 resolution.

    If I change Mode from Windowed to anything else (while keeping 1920×1080), no crash occurs.

    If I keep Windowed mode but change the resolution (e.g: to 2000×1080), the crash does not happen.


    I am using a 1080p monitor.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The bug is happening with a brand new empty project, any root node 2D / control etc... 

project.godot
